verdict.rationale: GeForce RTX 5070 Ti is a consumer gaming/creator GPU; evidence covers DLSS, Reflex, NVENC, CUDA toolkit for local dev, but there is no mention of NVLink, SLI/multi-GPU support, Infinity Fabric, or rack-scale datacenter deployment — GeForce cards lack NVLink since the 40-series and are not sold for datacenter clustering.
